text: GitHub Trending（DSH 插件，网页客户端）：查询 GitHub 上当前热门的代码仓库。它注册 github_trending 工具，并在网页侧栏提供趋势面板。可按编程语言筛选，查看每日、每周或每月趋势与排名、描述、语言、星标和 fork 数；侧栏支持刷新、折叠和调整宽度。适合发现近期流行的开源项目。插件从 GitHub 获取公开 Trending 页面数据，不需要额外 API Key。

GitHub Trending helps DSH users find popular repositories. Filter by language and daily, weekly, or monthly period, then view ranked projects and star counts. A web side panel shows trends and can be refreshed, collapsed, or resized. It reads public GitHub pages and needs no API key.
想按编程语言查 GitHub 上最近热门的开源仓库。
列出本周正在走红的 GitHub 项目，最好带上星标和简介。
有没有办法在 DSH 网页界面里直接浏览 GitHub 趋势榜？
帮我查看今天或本月 GitHub Trending 上有哪些项目。
Find trending GitHub repositories for a programming language and time period.
Show me popular open-source projects in a web panel while I use DSH.
GitHub Trending 的功能「趋势查询」：调用 github_trending 工具，按语言、每日/每周/每月周期筛选仓库，并返回排名、描述、星标等信息；默认最多 10 条，最多 25 条。
GitHub Trending 的功能「网页侧栏」：在 web 界面显示每日、每周或每月趋势，可刷新、折叠或调整宽度，并打开仓库链接。
GitHub Trending 使用公开网页作为数据来源，插件会向 github.com 请求所选语言和周期对应的趋势页面；未配置 API Key。
@wangjunjian/dsh-github-trending 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 75 天；提交数 5；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

@wangjunjian/dsh-github-trending README · @wangjunjian/dsh-github-trending：[中文](README.zh.md) | English

A DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin that exposes a `github_trending` tool backed by
https://github.com/trending, plus a right-hand trending panel in the `web`
profile.

@wangjunjian/dsh-github-trending README · What it does：The plugin registers one model-facing tool, `github_trending`, that fetches the
public GitHub Trending page for a given language and time window and returns a
structured list of trending repositories.

Each result includes:

@wangjunjian/dsh-github-trending README · What it does：- `rank` — 1-based position on the page
- `owner` / `name` / `fullName`
- `url` — absolute GitHub repository URL
- `description` — repository tagline
- `language` — primary language
- `stars` — total star count
- `forks` — fork count
- `starsToday` — stars gained today (or this week/month)
@wangjunjian/dsh-github-trending README · From a local checkout：dsh plugin --profile headless add /Users/junjian/GitHub/wang-junjian/dsh-github-trending

@wangjunjian/dsh-github-trending README · Or from the npm registry：dsh plugin --profile headless add @wangjunjian/dsh-github-trending
```

Use `--profile web` to also get the trending panel in the browser UI. The
bundle is appended to `dsh.profile.bundles` automatically.

@wangjunjian/dsh-github-trending README · Usage：Ask the agent to list trending repositories:

```text
Show me today's trending Python repositories.
```

@wangjunjian/dsh-github-trending README · Tool parameters：| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `language` | `string` | no | Programming language filter, e.g. `python`, `typescript`, `go`. |
| `since` | `string` | no | `daily` (default), `weekly`, or `monthly`. |
| `maxResults` | `integer` | no | Maximum repositories to return (default 10, hard cap 25). |

@wangjunjian/dsh-github-trending README · Cordis config：The bundle patch inserts one row by default. You can override its config in your
profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: github-trending
  config:
    enabled: true
    timeoutMs: 30000

@wangjunjian/dsh-github-trending README · Cordis config：| Field | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Whether to register the tool, cache, and web route. |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Cooperative timeout budget (ms) for each HTTP request. |
| `maxResults` | `10` | Maximum repositories the tool may return (clamped to 25). |
| `refreshIntervalMs` | `14400000` | Background refresh interval (ms) for the UI cache (4 hours). |

@wangjunjian/dsh-github-trending README · Development：```sh
pnpm install           # install dependencies (pnpm 10; also builds via prepare)
pnpm run build         # tsc -b tsconfig.json && tsdown
pnpm run test          # vitest run
pnpm run typecheck     # tsc --noEmit

`scripts/screenshot_test.py` is a manual development aid that drives a local
Playwright browser against `http://127.0.0.1:3080` to screenshot the web panel;
it is not part of the test suite and requires a local Playwright install.

@wangjunjian/dsh-github-trending README · Known limitations：- GitHub Trending has no official API. The parser targets the current
  server-rendered HTML layout and may need updates if GitHub changes markup.
- Unauthenticated requests are subject to GitHub's IP rate limits.
- The plugin fetches GitHub directly rather than through `ctx.web`, so it does
  not inherit the harness web capability's fetch policies.
- The panel floats over the app via `shell.overlay`; no native right-column
  slot exists in DSH yet.
@wangjunjian/dsh-github-trending 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 75 天；提交数 5；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。
